title: LootSource
description: Technology-neutral definition of a loot source in GUMFALL. Every item in the game traces back to a specific source — monster drop, chest, craft, quest reward, or event. This supports Core Pillar 8 (source-grounded loot). Protected drop rate details (weights, seed values, exact probability configurations) must remain in design-private/.

id.description: Unique identifier for this loot source definition. Use kebab-case.

source_id.description: References the monster id, chest id, crafting recipe id, quest id, or event id that owns this loot source.

level_band.description: Level range in which this loot source is active.

drop_table.description: Loot table entries for this source. NOTE: Exact weight values and seed configurations are protected design data — specific numeric weights for protected items must remain in design-private/. Public entries may use relative weight descriptors.

item_id.description: Item identifier. References a weapon, armor, consumable, or material definition.

weight.description: Relative drop weight. May be an integer weight or a qualitative descriptor. Exact numeric weights for protected loot remain in design-private/.

conditions.description: Conditions that must be true for this entry to be eligible.

guaranteed.description: True if this item always drops when conditions are met (e.g., quest key items).

max_per_instance.description: Maximum number of this item that can drop per encounter instance.

diminishing_returns.description: True if repeat farming of this source reduces drop probability for this item. VERIFIED: repeat farming diminishes.

currency_drops.description: Currency types that can drop from this source.

xp_award.description: XP awarded from this source. Diminishing returns apply on repeat farming.

base_xp.description: Base XP before level-scaling and rank modifiers.

rank_scaling.description: Whether XP scales with monster rank.

diminishing_returns.description: VERIFIED: repeat farming diminishes XP. Always true for combat sources.

notes.description: Internal design notes, authority labels, or protected configuration references.
